## Overview

**Condo Rent Price Prediction in Phnom Penh** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Monthly rent regression from Phnom Penh rental listings.

## Background & Motivation

PDS project on **condo rent price prediction in Phnom Penh** (collection folder). Complements sale-price condo analysis with rental-specific features.

Phnom Penh's rental market moves quickly; expatriates and locals need rent benchmarks by district, size, and furnishing.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

- Scrape rental listings (monthly rent, district, m², bedrooms, furnishing)
- Clean currency and numeric fields
- EDA: rent/m² by district
- Regression with MAE/RMSE on test set
- Optional: compare furnished vs. unfurnished premiums

## Data Collection & Preparation

Phnom Penh rental listings from marketplace scrapes (CSV in project).

## Methodology & Analysis

Feature encoding for location and unit attributes; regression; district-level error analysis.

## Model Evaluation

MAE/RMSE on held-out rentals; interpret top features (district, size).

## Results & Key Learnings

Rent estimation playbook for Phnom Penh condo rentals.
